name: Plantar Fascia Rupture
definition: Partial or complete disruption of plantar fascia, occurring acutely during sport or occasionally after corticosteroid injection.

investigations.principle: Ultrasound or MRI confirms tear and extent.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, cartilage, ligament or occult injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Most cases are nonoperative, but persistent arch instability needs specialist review.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-Snayu rupture phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Partial or complete disruption of plantar fascia, occurring acutely during sport or occasionally after corticosteroid injection.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, unreduced dislocation, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
